---

This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/run_16s_v2_common_region.qmd`. It evaluates whether the three earlier
U+B40 samples from PRJEB38595 (single-end, 300 bp MiSeq, 515F-primed) can be
compared with the current PRJEB79569 samples (paired-end, 301 bp MiSeq,
515F/907R), and produces a descriptive comparison where that is defensible.

Compatibility decision encoded here:

- Both cohorts begin with the 515F primer (verified on the reads, about 94% of
  earlier reads carry the exact degenerate prefix) and neither reaches the 907R
  site within a single read, so the amplicon is the same V4-V5 product.
- The only homologous sequence shared by every read in both cohorts is the
  forward read downstream of 515F. The common region is therefore defined as
  the first `trunc_len` bases after primer removal (default 250, where mean
  quality is still above 30 in both cohorts), forward reads only.
- Paired-end ASVs from the accepted v1 run and forward-only ASVs are different
  sequence definitions and are never concatenated. The current cohort is
  re-denoised on the common region inside v2, so both cohorts share one ASV
  definition, with SEPARATE error models and separate chimera removal per
  cohort (different runs, different library preparations).
- The earlier cohort is a separate study, a different specimen (attached
  biofilm, not Initial or Backflush liquid) and a different protocol. Nothing
  here treats it as cycle 0 and no cross-cohort inference is attempted.
  Between-cohort separation in an ordination is a study/specimen/batch
  difference until proven otherwise.

```sh
source config/16s_v2_paths.sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_16s_v2_common_region.qmd \
  [current_r1_dir] [earlier_se_dir] [reference_dir] [output_dir] [trunc_len]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: run-16s-v2-common-region
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
current_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_SUBSAMPLED_DIR")
earlier_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else file.path(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED"), "11_earlier_cohort_primer_removal")
reference_dir <- if (length(args) >= 3L) args[[3L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_REFERENCE_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 4L) args[[4L]] else file.path(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED"), "12_common_region")
trunc_len <- as.integer(if (length(args) >= 5L) args[[5L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_V2_COMMON_TRUNC_LEN", "250"))
if (!nzchar(current_dir) || !nzchar(earlier_dir) || !nzchar(reference_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide the four directories, or source config/16s_v2_paths.sh first.")
}
for (pkg in c("dada2", "vegan", "ggplot2")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package %s is required.", pkg)
}
protected <- c("derived/16s_analysis", "derived/16s_manuscript_integration",
               "phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569", "OneDrive-nium.io")
for (p in protected) if (grepl(p, output_dir, fixed = TRUE)) abort("output_dir resolves into protected location %s", p)
threads <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_THREADS", "4"))
learn_nbases <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_LEARN_NBASES", "5e7"))
min_boot <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_MIN_BOOT", "80"))
set.seed(20260901L)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
notebook <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH", unset = "")
repo_root <- if (nzchar(notebook)) dirname(dirname(notebook)) else getwd()
source(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))
library(dada2)

read_tsv <- function(path) read.delim(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
                                      check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write_tsv <- function(x, name) write.table(x, file.path(output_dir, name), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
                                           row.names = FALSE, na = "")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ cohorts
current_meta <- read_tsv(file.path(repo_root, "metadata", "sample_metadata.tsv"))
earlier_meta <- read_tsv(file.path(repo_root, "metadata", "16s_v2_earlier_cohort_sample_map.tsv"))
current_files <- setNames(file.path(current_dir, paste0(current_meta$sample_title, "_R1.trimmed.fastq.gz")), current_meta$sample_title)
earlier_files <- setNames(file.path(earlier_dir, paste0(earlier_meta$sample_title, "_SE.trimmed.fastq.gz")), earlier_meta$sample_title)
missing <- c(current_files, earlier_files)[!file.exists(c(current_files, earlier_files))]
if (length(missing)) abort("Missing primer-free reads: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

cohorts <- list(
  current = list(files = current_files, label = "current_PRJEB79569"),
  earlier = list(files = earlier_files, label = "earlier_PRJEB38595_UplusB40")
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------- per-cohort DADA2
# Forward reads only, one common truncation, and SEPARATE error models per
# cohort. pool = FALSE and consensus chimera removal match the accepted v1 run.
filtered_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "filtered")
dir.create(filtered_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
retention <- list()
seqtabs <- list()
error_models <- list()
# Denoising is the expensive part. A completed per-cohort table is reused on
# rerun; delete the cache files under output_dir/cache to force re-denoising.
cache_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "cache")
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (co in names(cohorts)) {
  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("%s_trunc%d.rds", co, trunc_len))
  if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
    cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
    seqtabs[[co]] <- cached$seqtab
    retention[[co]] <- cached$retention
    cat("Reusing cached denoising for cohort", co, "\n")
    next
  }
  files <- cohorts[[co]]$files
  filt <- setNames(file.path(filtered_dir, paste0(names(files), ".", co, ".filt.fastq.gz")), names(files))
  track <- filterAndTrim(files, filt, truncLen = trunc_len, maxEE = 2, truncQ = 2, maxN = 0,
                         rm.phix = TRUE, compress = TRUE, multithread = threads)
  err <- learnErrors(filt, nbases = learn_nbases, multithread = threads, randomize = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
  error_models[[co]] <- err
  grDevices::pdf(file.path(output_dir, sprintf("16s_v2_common_region_error_model_%s.pdf", co)), width = 9, height = 7)
  print(plotErrors(err, nominalQ = TRUE))
  grDevices::dev.off()
  dd <- dada(filt, err = err, pool = FALSE, multithread = threads, verbose = FALSE)
  st <- makeSequenceTable(dd)
  st_nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(st, method = "consensus", multithread = threads, verbose = FALSE)
  rownames(st_nochim) <- names(files)
  seqtabs[[co]] <- st_nochim
  retention[[co]] <- data.frame(
    cohort = cohorts[[co]]$label, sample_title = names(files),
    input_reads = track[, "reads.in"], filtered_reads = track[, "reads.out"],
    denoised_reads = vapply(dd, function(x) sum(getUniques(x)), numeric(1)),
    nonchimeric_reads = rowSums(st_nochim),
    fraction_retained_overall = round(rowSums(st_nochim) / track[, "reads.in"], 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  saveRDS(list(seqtab = st_nochim, retention = retention[[co]]), cache_file)
}
seqtab <- mergeSequenceTables(tables = seqtabs)
asv_ids <- sprintf("CR%04d", seq_len(ncol(seqtab)))
sequences <- colnames(seqtab)
colnames(seqtab) <- asv_ids
saveRDS(seqtab, file.path(output_dir, "16s_v2_common_region_seqtab.rds"))
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, retention), "16s_v2_common_region_read_retention.tsv")
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(Biostrings::DNAStringSet(setNames(sequences, asv_ids)),
                            file.path(output_dir, "16s_v2_common_region_asv_sequences.fasta"))
write_tsv(data.frame(asv_id = asv_ids, t(seqtab), check.names = FALSE),
          "16s_v2_common_region_asv_counts_unrarefied.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- taxonomy
silva <- file.path(reference_dir, "silva_nr99_v138.2_toGenus_trainset.fa.gz")
if (!file.exists(silva)) abort("SILVA training set missing: %s", silva)
tax_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("taxonomy_trunc%d.rds", trunc_len))
tax <- if (file.exists(tax_cache)) readRDS(tax_cache) else assignTaxonomy(sequences, silva, minBoot = min_boot, multithread = threads)
saveRDS(tax, tax_cache)
rownames(tax) <- asv_ids
taxonomy <- data.frame(asv_id = asv_ids, tax, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
write_tsv(taxonomy, "16s_v2_common_region_asv_taxonomy_silva138.2.tsv")

# ------------------------------------------------------------- sample table
samples <- rbind(
  data.frame(sample_title = current_meta$sample_title, cohort = "current_PRJEB79569",
             condition = current_meta$condition, phase = current_meta$phase,
             cycle = as.character(current_meta$cycle), specimen = "liquid", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  data.frame(sample_title = earlier_meta$sample_title, cohort = "earlier_PRJEB38595_UplusB40",
             condition = "earlier_phage_uv", phase = "attached_biofilm", cycle = "unassigned",
             specimen = "attached_biofilm", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
rownames(samples) <- samples$sample_title
seqtab <- seqtab[samples$sample_title, , drop = FALSE]
samples$library_size <- rowSums(seqtab)
write_tsv(samples, "16s_v2_common_region_sample_table.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------- descriptive comparison
relative <- sweep(seqtab, 1L, rowSums(seqtab), "/")
present <- seqtab > 0
shared <- data.frame(
  asvs_total = ncol(seqtab),
  asvs_in_current = sum(colSums(present[samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0),
  asvs_in_earlier = sum(colSums(present[samples$cohort != "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0),
  asvs_shared = sum(colSums(present[samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0 &
                    colSums(present[samples$cohort != "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0))
shared$reads_in_earlier_from_shared_asvs <- round(sum(relative[samples$cohort != "current_PRJEB79569",
  colSums(present[samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0]) / sum(samples$cohort != "current_PRJEB79569"), 4)
shared$reads_in_current_from_shared_asvs <- round(sum(relative[samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569",
  colSums(present[samples$cohort != "current_PRJEB79569", ]) > 0]) / sum(samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569"), 4)
write_tsv(shared, "16s_v2_common_region_shared_asvs.tsv")

# Alpha diversity, unrarefied plus a rarefied sensitivity at the smallest depth.
min_depth <- min(samples$library_size)
rarefied <- vegan::rrarefy(seqtab, min_depth)
alpha <- data.frame(
  samples[, c("sample_title", "cohort", "condition", "phase", "cycle", "library_size")],
  observed_asvs = rowSums(seqtab > 0), shannon = vegan::diversity(seqtab, "shannon"),
  observed_asvs_rarefied = rowSums(rarefied > 0), shannon_rarefied = vegan::diversity(rarefied, "shannon"),
  rarefaction_depth = min_depth, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write_tsv(alpha, "16s_v2_common_region_alpha_diversity.tsv")

# Beta diversity: Bray-Curtis on relative abundance and Aitchison on CLR.
clr <- t(apply(log2(seqtab + 0.5), 1L, function(x) x - mean(x)))
distances <- list(bray_curtis = vegan::vegdist(relative, "bray"), aitchison = dist(clr))
ordination <- list()
dispersion_summary <- list()
for (metric in names(distances)) {
  d <- distances[[metric]]
  pc <- cmdscale(d, k = 2L, eig = TRUE)
  var_explained <- pc$eig[1:2] / sum(pc$eig[pc$eig > 0])
  ordination[[metric]] <- data.frame(metric = metric, samples[rownames(pc$points), ],
    axis1 = pc$points[, 1L], axis2 = pc$points[, 2L],
    axis1_variance = round(var_explained[1L], 4), axis2_variance = round(var_explained[2L], 4),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  m <- as.matrix(d)
  is_current <- samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569"
  within_current <- m[is_current, is_current][upper.tri(m[is_current, is_current])]
  within_earlier <- m[!is_current, !is_current][upper.tri(m[!is_current, !is_current])]
  between <- as.vector(m[is_current, !is_current])
  dispersion_summary[[metric]] <- data.frame(metric = metric,
    mean_within_current = round(mean(within_current), 4), mean_within_earlier = round(mean(within_earlier), 4),
    mean_between_cohorts = round(mean(between), 4),
    reading = "descriptive; between-cohort distance reflects study, specimen and batch as well as biology",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, ordination), "16s_v2_common_region_ordination_coordinates.tsv")
write_tsv(do.call(rbind, dispersion_summary), "16s_v2_common_region_distance_summary.tsv")

# Current cohort alone on the common region: marginal R2 for the three design
# terms, reported as DESCRIPTIVE effect sizes. No permutation p-value is
# carried, because one membrane per condition and repeated observations do not
# support an unrestricted permutation test (return-receipt audit, 2026-09-04).
cur <- samples[samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", ]
cur$condition <- factor(cur$condition); cur$phase <- factor(cur$phase); cur$cycle <- factor(cur$cycle)
r2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(distances), function(metric) {
  d <- as.dist(as.matrix(distances[[metric]])[cur$sample_title, cur$sample_title])
  # A handful of permutations only so vegan returns the partition; the p-value
  # column is deliberately not written.
  fit <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ cycle + phase + condition, data = cur, permutations = 9, by = "margin")
  data.frame(metric = metric, term = rownames(fit)[1:3], r2 = round(fit$R2[1:3], 4),
             note = "marginal R2 on the forward-only common region; descriptive, no permutation p-value",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
write_tsv(r2, "16s_v2_common_region_current_cohort_marginal_r2.tsv")

# Family-level composition, with unclassified kept distinct.
family <- taxonomy$Family
family[is.na(family) | family == ""] <- "Unclassified at family level"
fam_rel <- t(rowsum(t(relative), group = family))
composition <- data.frame(sample_title = rep(rownames(fam_rel), ncol(fam_rel)),
                          family = rep(colnames(fam_rel), each = nrow(fam_rel)),
                          relative_abundance = as.vector(fam_rel), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
composition <- merge(composition, samples[, c("sample_title", "cohort", "condition", "phase", "cycle")], by = "sample_title")
write_tsv(composition[composition$relative_abundance > 0, ], "16s_v2_common_region_family_profile_long.tsv")

# -------------------------------------------------------------- figures
library(ggplot2)
samples$cohort_label <- ifelse(samples$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", "Current study (2 membranes, 3 cycles)", "Earlier study U+B40 (attached biofilm)")
ord <- do.call(rbind, ordination)
ord$cohort_label <- samples$cohort_label[match(ord$sample_title, samples$sample_title)]
ord$membrane <- ifelse(ord$cohort == "current_PRJEB79569", ord$condition, "earlier")
ord$membrane <- factor(ord$membrane, levels = c("control", "treatment", "earlier"))
p_ord <- ggplot(ord, aes(axis1, axis2, colour = membrane, shape = cohort_label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
                                 treatment = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]], earlier = "#555555"),
                      labels = c(control = "Control membrane", treatment = "Phage-UV membrane", earlier = "Earlier U+B40"),
                      name = "Membrane / cohort") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 4), name = "Cohort") +
  labs(x = "PCoA axis 1", y = "PCoA axis 2",
       caption = "Forward-only common region after 515F.\nCohort separation reflects study, specimen and batch; not a treatment or temporal effect.") +
  theme_phage_uv()
grDevices::pdf(file.path(output_dir, "16s-v2-common-region-ordination.pdf"), width = 7.2, height = 3.6, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_ord)
grDevices::dev.off()

top_families <- names(sort(colMeans(fam_rel[, colnames(fam_rel) != "Unclassified at family level", drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:15]
comp <- composition
comp$family_shown <- ifelse(comp$family %in% top_families, comp$family,
                            ifelse(comp$family == "Unclassified at family level", comp$family, "Other classified families"))
comp <- aggregate(relative_abundance ~ sample_title + cohort + family_shown, comp, sum)
comp$family_shown <- factor(comp$family_shown, levels = c(top_families, "Other classified families", "Unclassified at family level"))
comp$sample_title <- factor(comp$sample_title, levels = samples$sample_title)
p_comp <- ggplot(comp, aes(sample_title, relative_abundance, fill = family_shown)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance", fill = "Family") +
  theme_phage_uv() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 6))
grDevices::pdf(file.path(output_dir, "16s-v2-common-region-family-composition.pdf"), width = 8.5, height = 4.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_comp)
grDevices::dev.off()

alpha$cohort_label <- samples$cohort_label[match(alpha$sample_title, samples$sample_title)]
alpha_long <- rbind(data.frame(alpha[, c("sample_title", "cohort_label", "condition")], index = "Observed ASVs", value = alpha$observed_asvs),
                    data.frame(alpha[, c("sample_title", "cohort_label", "condition")], index = "Shannon", value = alpha$shannon))
p_alpha <- ggplot(alpha_long, aes(cohort_label, value, colour = condition)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) + facet_wrap(~ index, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(phage_uv_condition_colours, earlier_phage_uv = "#555555")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = "Unrarefied; rarefied sensitivity in the alpha table.") +
  theme_phage_uv() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6))
grDevices::pdf(file.path(output_dir, "16s-v2-common-region-alpha-diversity.pdf"), width = 7.2, height = 3.2, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_alpha)
grDevices::dev.off()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- provenance
write_tsv(data.frame(
  parameter = c("common_region", "trunc_len", "max_ee", "trunc_q", "pool", "chimera_method", "learn_error_nbases",
                "error_models", "min_boot", "taxonomy", "threads", "dada2_version", "r_version", "run_timestamp_utc"),
  value = c("forward read after 515F removal", trunc_len, 2, 2, "FALSE", "consensus", format(learn_nbases, scientific = TRUE),
            "separate per cohort", min_boot, "SILVA 138.2 nr99 toGenus", threads,
            as.character(packageVersion("dada2")), paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
            format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"))), "16s_v2_common_region_parameters.tsv")
inputs <- c(current_files, earlier_files, silva)
write_tsv(data.frame(file = inputs, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(inputs))), "16s_v2_common_region_input_checksums.tsv")
outputs <- setdiff(list.files(output_dir, recursive = FALSE), c("filtered", "cache", "16s_v2_common_region_output_checksums.tsv"))
write_tsv(data.frame(file = outputs, bytes = file.size(file.path(output_dir, outputs)),
                     md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(output_dir, outputs)))), "16s_v2_common_region_output_checksums.tsv")
print(do.call(rbind, retention)[, c("cohort", "sample_title", "input_reads", "nonchimeric_reads", "fraction_retained_overall")])
print(shared)
print(do.call(rbind, dispersion_summary))
print(r2)
```
